headline: Crimson Tide Test Buffaloes in Week 4 Clash
subhead: No. 6 Alabama visits No. 16 Colorado with contrasting offensive identities on display.

xFactor.why: James Cortez leads the PCFL with 943 passing yards and six touchdowns through three games.

keyMatchup: Alabama's 299-yard passing attack against a Colorado defense allowing 422.3 yards per game.
body: Alabama arrives at 2-1 and sixth in the power poll after climbing four spots, fueled by a 363.3-yard offense that leans heavily on Cortez's 943 yards and six scores through the air. The Tide have won two straight and average 23 points per game, but their defense has yielded 472.3 yards per contest, ranking 17th in the league.

Colorado sits 1-2 and 16th in the poll following a 39-23 loss to Boston College, yet the Buffaloes put up 28.7 points per game behind Sam B Leavitt's 796 yards and five touchdowns. Bo B MacCormick adds 142 rushing yards and three scores, while the defense allows 422.3 yards per game and features Griffen B Collins with two sacks and Shilo Sanders with an interception.
